content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-50. - Pay plan and classification system.
content.summary:
The city will provide its employees with a classification system and pay plan that
               meets the city's total rewards philosophy and complies with all applicable federal
               and state laws.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
